# The Golden Hour

> Aspen and Roaring Fork Valley pocket guide. Current facts require fresh primary-source checks.

- [Agent methodology](https://thegoldenhour.guide/agents/)
- [Current week](https://thegoldenhour.guide/upcoming/)
- [Calendar](https://thegoldenhour.guide/calendar/)

Events originate only from the two public AURELIAN calendars: Around Aspen and Regional Events Intelligence. Personal and Ritz-Carlton calendars are excluded. Calendar export metadata describes its last supplied refresh; the trust line is an editorial standard, not proof that a later refresh occurred.

Only verified events are eligible. Routine worship, regular classes and standing hours are not events; seasonal specials may qualify. FEATURED/LISTED bands are assigned upstream; numerical scoring is not inferred. Event imagery is verified subject-specific imagery or absent.

Use America/Denver dates. Google date-only end dates are exclusive. A record remains current through its local end date and enters history the next day. Historical events are research candidates, never automatically re-listed. Re-verify any future edition with its original source.

Runtime lists and structured data must agree. Feed failure must not silently fall back to an old edition. Generated overview URLs are stable; explicit official-source actions are the booking exit.
